```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const pt = ee.Geometry.Point([85.883, 20.462]); // Cuttack, Odisha (approx)
  const roi = pt.buffer(5000); // 5 km buffer
  const date1 = '2019-04-30';
  const date2 = '2019-05-04';
  const scale = 1000;

  // Helper to compute total pixel count once (at scale over roi)
  async function getTotalCount() {
    try {
      const total = await ee.Image(1).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('constant').getInfo();
      return total || 0;
    } catch (e) {
      return 0;
    }
  }

  // Try daily Black Marble first
  async function getDailyStats(dateStr, windowDays, preferGapFilled) {
    const start = ee.Date(dateStr).advance(windowDays < 1 ? 0 : Math.floor(-(windowDays - 1) / 2), 'day');
    const end = ee.Date(dateStr).advance(windowDays < 1 ? 1 : Math.ceil((windowDays + 1) / 2), 'day');
    const datasetId = 'NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A2';
    let col;
    try {
      col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(roi);
    } catch (e) {
      return { ok: false, err: 'dataset_error' };
    }
    const size = await col.size().getInfo();
    if (!size || size === 0) {
      return { ok: false, empty: true, images: 0, datasetId };
    }

    let firstBands;
    try {
      firstBands = await col.first().bandNames().getInfo();
    } catch (e) {
      return { ok: false, err: 'bandnames_error', images: size, datasetId };
    }
    const candidates = preferGapFilled
      ? ['Gap_Filled_DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL', 'DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL', 'avg_rad']
      : ['DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL', 'Gap_Filled_DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL', 'avg_rad'];
    let band = null;
    for (const b of candidates) {
      if (firstBands && firstBands.indexOf(b) !== -1) { band = b; break; }
    }
    if (!band) {
      return { ok: false, err: 'band_not_found', images: size, datasetId, bands: firstBands };
    }

    const img = col.mosaic().select(band);
    let stats;
    try {
      const meanDict = await img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).getInfo();
      const mean = meanDict ? meanDict[band + '_mean'] : null;
      const count = meanDict ? meanDict[band + '_count'] : 0;
      return { ok: true, datasetId, images: size, band, mean, count };
    } catch (e) {
      return { ok: false, err: 'reduceregion_error', images: size, datasetId };
    }
  }

  // Fallback monthly stats
  async function getMonthlyStats(dateStr) {
    const d = ee.Date(dateStr);
    const start = d.update({ day: 1 });
    const end = start.advance(1, 'month');
    const datasetId = 'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG';
    let col;
    try {
      col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(roi);
    } catch (e) {
      return { ok: false, err: 'dataset_error' };
    }
    const size = await col.size().getInfo();
    if (!size || size === 0) {
      return { ok: false, empty: true, images: 0, datasetId };
    }
    const band = 'avg_rad';
    const img = col.mosaic().select(band);
    try {
      const meanDict = await img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).getInfo();
      const mean = meanDict ? meanDict[band + '_mean'] : null;
      const count = meanDict ? meanDict[band + '_count'] : 0;
      return { ok: true, datasetId, images: size, band, mean, count, monthly: true };
    } catch (e) {
      return { ok: false, err: 'reduceregion_error', images: size, datasetId };
    }
  }

  // Validate mean value
  function isBad(val) {
    return val === null || val === undefined || Number.isNaN(val) || !isFinite(val) || val < 0;
  }

  try {
    const totalCount = await getTotalCount();
    if (!totalCount || totalCount === 0) {
      console.log('Total pixels: 0 (geometry/scale issue)');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Primary attempt: daily (exact day window)
    let s1 = await getDailyStats(date1, 1, true);
    let s2 = await getDailyStats(date2, 1, true);

    // If any empty, retry with 3-day window centered
    if (!s1.ok || s1.count === 0 || isBad(s1.mean)) {
      const retry = await getDailyStats(date1, 3, true);
      if (retry.ok) s1 = retry;
    }
    if (!s2.ok || s2.count === 0 || isBad(s2.mean)) {
      const retry = await getDailyStats(date2, 3, true);
      if (retry.ok) s2 = retry;
    }

    let usedMonthly = false;
    // If still problematic for either, fallback to monthly for both
    if (!s1.ok || !s2.ok || s1.count === 0 || s2.count === 0 || isBad(s1.mean) || isBad(s2.mean)) {
      const m1 = await getMonthlyStats(date1);
      const m2 = await getMonthlyStats(date2);
      if (m1.ok && m2.ok && m1.count > 0 && m2.count > 0 && !isBad(m1.mean) && !isBad(m2.mean)) {
        s1 = m1; s2 = m2; usedMonthly = true;
      }
    }

    // Final validation
    if ((!s1.ok && !s1.monthly) || (!s2.ok && !s2.monthly)) {
      // If collections were empty
      if ((s1 && s1.empty) || (s2 && s2.empty)) {
        console.log('Empty collection for one/both dates after recovery.');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
      console.log('Processing error.');
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }
    if (s1.count === 0 || s2.count === 0) {
      console.log('No valid pixels after processing for one/both dates.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (isBad(s1.mean) || isBad(s2.mean)) {
      console.log('Invalid calculation (null/NaN) for one/both dates.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Reporting (concise)
    const validPct1 = (100 * s1.count / totalCount);
    const validPct2 = (100 * s2.count / totalCount);
    const dsLabel = usedMonthly ? 'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG' : 'NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A2';
    console.log(`Dataset: ${dsLabel}${usedMonthly ? ' (monthly fallback)' : ' (daily)'}`);
    console.log(`${date1} - imgs:${s1.images}, band:${s1.band}, mean:${s1.mean.toFixed(2)}, valid:${s1.count}/${totalCount} (${validPct1.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`${date2} - imgs:${s2.images}, band:${s2.band}, mean:${s2.mean.toFixed(2)}, valid:${s2.count}/${totalCount} (${validPct2.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    const diff = s2.mean - s1.mean;
    const decreased = diff < 0;
    console.log(`Diff (May 4 - Apr 30): ${diff.toFixed(2)}${usedMonthly ? ' (monthly avg)' : ''}`);
    console.log(decreased ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
